questions.content: What are the speakers discussing?
options: The safety inspection of company delivery vans
The purchase of new freight transport vehicles
A delay in manufacturing automotive replacement parts

questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ hỏi: "Has the fleet maintenance crew finished inspecting our delivery vans?" → Cuộc hội thoại nói về việc kiểm định xe tải giao hàng (A).

questions.content: What minor issue does Carlos mention regarding Van Number 3?
options: A headlight bulb needs to be replaced
Its side cargo door cannot be locked
Its windshield has a visible crack

questions.content: When do the speakers expect drivers to depart?
questions.explanation: Carlos nói: "That way all drivers will be on the road before 1:00 P.M." → Chọn (A).

options: Repainting pedestrian walkways and installing safety railings
questions.explanation: Thông báo nêu: "contractors will be repainting safety pedestrian walkways and installing heavy-duty safety railings..." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Which loading bays will be closed until Friday afternoon?
options: All bays on the northern concourse
questions.explanation: Thông báo: "As a result, Loading Bays 4 through 7 will be temporarily closed until Friday afternoon" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What safety equipment must all staff wear in staging areas?
questions.explanation: Thông báo nhắc: "...high-visibility reflective vests and steel-toe work boots are mandatory in all active staging areas" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Warehouse safety regulations will be ------- enforced across all regional logistics hubs beginning next Monday.
questions.explanation: Đứng giữa trợ động từ "will be" và động từ phân từ hai "enforced" cần một phó từ (adverb) chỉ mức độ → chọn "strictly" (một cách nghiêm ngặt).

questions.content: The certified inspector will ------- the automated conveyor belt before regular production shifts resume.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu "will" cần một động từ nguyên mẫu không "to" (bare infinitive) → chọn "inspect" (thanh tra, kiểm tra).

questions.content: Commercial truck drivers must submit ------- daily delivery mileage logs to dispatch every evening.
questions.explanation: Đứng trước cụm danh từ "daily delivery mileage logs" cần tính từ sở hữu số nhiều tương ứng với "Commercial truck drivers" → chọn "their" (của họ).

questions.content: The container vessel remained anchored outside the harbor ------- port customs officials reviewed the shipping manifests.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề ("port customs officials reviewed the shipping manifests") diễn tả hành động diễn ra đồng thời → chọn liên từ thời gian "while" (trong khi).

questions.content: Perishable food supplies arriving at the fulfillment center must be placed ------- designated refrigeration rooms.
questions.explanation: Giới từ chỉ vị trí bên trong phòng lạnh bảo quản hàng tươi sống → chọn "inside" (bên trong).

groups.passage:
PACIFIC CARGO LOGISTICS
Customer Advisory: Shipment Tracking #PC-884920
Date: October 18
Recipient: Starlight Electronics Ltd.

Dear Valued Client,

We are writing to provide an important update regarding your shipment of precision semiconductor components (Tracking ID: PC-884920). Due to severe weather conditions along the Western Pacific maritime corridor, your container vessel was required to seek temporary anchorage outside Kaohsiung Harbor for maritime safety.

As a direct consequence of this necessary detour, the estimated arrival at the Port of Long Beach has been [131] ------- from October 22 to October 27. [132] -------. Our customs brokerage unit has already pre-filed all electronic import documentation to ensure cargo is discharged rapidly upon berthing.

Once the container is unloaded, our certified transport partner will deliver the freight [133] ------- to your Irvine assembly facility. We sincerely regret any inconvenience caused by this unavoidable maritime delay. For continuous real-time container updates, please log in to your account dashboard or [134] ------- with your dedicated client manager.

questions.content: Choose the best verb form to fill in blank [131].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động thì hiện tại hoàn thành: "has been + V3/ed" → chọn "rescheduled" (đã được dời lịch từ 22 sang 27 tháng 10).

questions.content: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank [132].
options: We are monitoring maritime advisories closely and will alert you to further updates.
Our corporate headquarters will host an executive banquet this weekend.
Please ensure all personal luggage is tagged before boarding the flight.
The annual software subscription fee has already been deducted.
questions.explanation: Câu trước vừa thông báo lùi ngày giao hàng do bão. Câu (A) nối tiếp thông tin trấn an và theo dõi sát sao ("Chúng tôi đang theo dõi sát sao và sẽ thông báo cho bạn").

questions.content: Choose the best adverb to fill in blank [133].
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "will deliver the freight" cần phó từ chỉ thể cách → chọn "directly" (giao hàng trực tiếp tới cơ sở lắp ráp của bạn).

questions.content: Choose the best verb to fill in blank [134].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc song hành với động từ nguyên mẫu đứng trước liên từ "or": "please log in ... or consult with ...".

groups.passage:
METRO TOWER MANAGEMENT
Tenant Advisory: Ground Lobby & Passenger Elevator Modernization
Date: July 15
To: All Building Occupants & Visitors

Please be advised that Metro Tower Management will begin comprehensive modernization work on our ground-floor entrance lobby and high-rise passenger elevator system starting Saturday, August 1.

Project Phases & Work Scope:
• Phase 1 (August 1 – August 14): Lobby flooring replacement and energy-efficient lighting installation. The main revolving entrance will be inaccessible; all tenants and guests must enter through the West Plaza side doors.
• Phase 2 (August 15 – August 31): High-rise elevator cab overhaul. Elevators 1 and 2 will be temporarily suspended, while Elevators 3 and 4 will operate express service servicing floors 12 through 25.

Noise & After-Hours Schedule:
To minimize business disruption, all noisy tile drilling and structural removal will occur strictly between 7:00 P.M. and 5:00 A.M. on weekdays, and throughout the weekend. Security officers will remain on duty at the West Plaza entrance 24 hours a day to assist guests and verify electronic access cards.

questions.content: What is the primary objective of this notice?
options: To inform tenants about scheduled lobby and elevator renovations
To announce an increase in monthly parking stall fees
To invite building occupants to an annual social reception
To warn employees about unexpected electrical power cuts
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề và nội dung thông báo đều tập trung vào việc hiện đại hóa sảnh chính tầng trệt và thang máy tòa nhà Metro Tower → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Where must tenants enter the building during Phase 1?
options: Through the West Plaza side doors
Via the underground parking loading dock
questions.explanation: Mục Phase 1: "The main revolving entrance will be inaccessible; all tenants and guests must enter through the West Plaza side doors" → Chọn (A).

groups.passage:
MEMORANDUM 1
To: Distribution Center Personnel
From: Kenji Sato, Operations Director, QuickFreight Logistics
Date: November 10
Subject: Implementation of Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGVs)

Beginning December 1, our primary fulfillment center in Indianapolis will integrate twelve Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGVs) into our warehouse pallet transport operations. These robotic units are engineered to transport loaded pallets from the packaging lines directly to the dispatch staging lanes, reducing manual forklift transit by forty percent.

To ensure smooth integration and maintain workplace safety, all warehouse associates must attend a mandatory 45-minute training session on AGV navigation sensors and emergency-stop protocols. Training sessions will be held daily in the main training room from November 20 to November 24.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MEMORANDUM 2
To: Kenji Sato, Operations Director
From: Maria Hernandez, Shift Supervisor
Date: November 25
Subject: AGV Training Attendance Completion

Dear Kenji,
I am pleased to report that 100% of our 85 shift workers have completed the AGV safety certification course as of this morning. Technician Davis from the robotics supplier conducted thorough demonstrations on battery charging docks and safety beacon indicators.

Our shift leads noted that the designated transit lanes for the AGVs along Corridor B are somewhat narrow. We suggest repainting the floor markings to give human foot traffic an extra two feet of clearance before the robots go live on December 1. Please let me know if maintenance can proceed with this adjustment over the holiday weekend.

Best regards,
Maria Hernandez

questions.content: What is the purpose of introducing Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGVs)?
options: To transport pallets from packaging lines to dispatch staging areas
To replace the warehouse security guard personnel
To package delicate glass items for international air freight
To inspect incoming freight delivery vehicles
questions.explanation: Mục đích AGVs: "transport loaded pallets from the packaging lines directly to the dispatch staging lanes" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What did Maria Hernandez report regarding the safety training?
options: All 85 shift associates successfully completed the course
The training sessions were postponed until December
The robotics technician failed to attend the demonstration
Half of the workers requested additional training sessions
questions.explanation: Maria Hernandez báo cáo: "100% of our 85 shift workers have completed the AGV safety certification course as of this morning" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What modification did Maria suggest before December 1?
options: Repainting floor markings in Corridor B to widen pedestrian clearance
Purchasing six additional robotic units from the supplier
Extending the battery charging time of the vehicles
questions.explanation: Maria đề xuất: "We suggest repainting the floor markings to give human foot traffic an extra two feet of clearance..." → Chọn (A).
